# DKR-032: Infrastructure containers run pinned images

- **Group:** Docker
- **Severity when it fails:** low
- **Root:** the full result needs `sudo`. Without root this check may report `unknown`; it never reports a pass it could not verify.

## Why it matters

The reverse proxy, the tunnel connector and CrowdSec sit in front of everything. On :latest or no tag, a pull or a recreate silently changes their version, which can break routing or protection at a random moment and makes it impossible to tell which version is running.

## Verify by hand

```sh
docker ps --format '{{.Names}} {{.Image}}'
```

## How to fix it

Pin a version tag (traefik:v3.1, cloudflare/cloudflared:2024.12.2) or a digest, and let an update watcher tell you when a new one is out.

## What a fix can break

Nothing until the next upgrade, which becomes a deliberate step.
